title: Chapter 313 - 313 You'Re A Bad Person!

Chapter 313 - 313 You'Re A Bad Person!

Chapter 313 - 313 You're a Bad Person!

313 You’re a Bad Person!

When Lin Fan heard the system notification, a weird look appeared on his face.

If he remembered correctly, it was Magpie Coffee that wanted to buy their coffee beans, right?

Now, he directly owned 10% shares of Magpie Coffee?

One had to know…

The first shareholder of Magpie Coffee had 23% of the shares, while the second shareholder only had 8% of the shares.

Thus, he had become the second shareholder?

In the past, he often heard others say that one could become a shareholder by speculating in stocks.

This time… had he been acquired and become a shareholder?

Lin Fan shook his head and tossed this small matter to the back of his mind.

He slowly got up and walked out.

At this moment, the sun was rising from the mountains in the distance. It gradually emitted a warm and gentle light. Coupled with the gentle breeze and sweet air, it made him feel extremely relaxed.

At this moment, Su Ningjing walked over.

When Lin Fan heard her voice, he raised his hand and hugged her slender waist.

There was beautiful nature in front of him and a beautiful woman hugging him.

Everything was so wonderful.

Time… It was as if the pause button had been pressed at this moment.

After an unknown period of time, a crisp voice sounded behind them.

“Sister, Brother, it’s time for breakfast!”

In an instant, Su Ningjing’s pretty face turned red. She reflexively tried to break free from Lin Fan’s embrace.

Just like yesterday, Lin Fan held her hand tightly.

Strong and warm, it made her feel at ease and happy.

For breakfast, Su Ningjing made sweet potatoes, yam, and corn and cooked up a few eggs that were taken from the chicken coop.

The meal was simple and delicious.

Just as they finished breakfast, a car roared outside.

Then, three men in suits and leather shoes strode in.

The man at the front looked at Su Ningjing.

Although he had already seen Su Ningjing’s beautiful face yesterday, when he saw it again, he was still stunned. His face was filled with fascination.

He had never thought that there would be such a beautiful woman in the mountain village.

“Ms. Su, have you thought about the one million yuan we offered to buy your coffee beans yesterday?” the man asked after a while.

One million? They wanted to buy the coffee beans from the system for one million?

This was a joke.

“Not really!” Lin Fan replied immediately.

The man frowned slightly. He seemed to have just realized that a man had appeared.

“Who are you?”

Lin Fan skillfully held Su Ningjing’s slender waist and said, “Ningjing’s boyfriend, Lin Fan.”

Even though Su Ningjing had already given everything to Lin Fan, she was hugged by Lin Fan in front of everyone. He even said that he was her boyfriend.

It still made her extremely shy. Her pretty face was like a ripe red apple, and she wished she could bury her little head in a hole.

When the man saw this, his face darkened.

After seeing Su Ningjing yesterday, he had already been secretly thinking about how to woo her.

However, she actually had a boyfriend?!

The man took a few deep breaths to calm himself down.

He said, “Ms. Su, I know that you grew up in this mountain village and are very innocent. This is a rare quality.

“However, I hope you understand that some people are not as innocent as you.”

As the man said this, his gaze landed on Lin Fan.

The meaning of this sentence was obvious.

“Mr. Lin, I don’t seem to have seen you in the village before. Yesterday, Magpie Coffee wanted to buy Ms. Su’s coffee beans at a high price of one million. Today, you immediately appeared…”

These words were clearly trying to sow discord and plant the seeds of distrust in Su Ningjing’s heart.

“Magpie Coffee not only has good coffee, but we also uphold a culture of innocence and efficiency,” the man continued.

“Ms. Su is the owner of this coffee plantation. We want to carry out the negotiation process efficiently. Magpie Coffee would like to talk to Ms. Su in private… We’re willing to pay a price higher than yesterday’s price… Ms. Smith, what do you think?”

First, he instigated discord and planted the seeds of distrust. Then, he let money do the talking…

If it were someone else, they would probably follow the man’s words and choose to discuss with him alone.

Unfortunately, he met Su Ningjing today.

In fact…

When the man said the first sentence, Su Ningjing already wanted to retort.

However, Lin Fan gave her a look and told her not to say anything.

That was why the man continued speaking.

At this moment, Su Ningjing could no longer hold it in and said angrily, “Our family doesn’t welcome you, nor will we do business with you. Please leave!”

The man stiffened slightly. He did not expect Su Ningjing to have such a big reaction and was at a loss for what to do.

Lin Fan gently patted Su Ningjing’s waist and said, “I don’t know if I’m innocent or not…However, you mentioned an efficient negotiation method just now, so there’s no problem for you to negotiate with me.

“Because I planted all the coffee here.”

The man looked at Lin Fan suspiciously.

Ah Mei, who was at the side, also felt the man’s hostility toward Lin Fan. She said angrily, “Brother took two days to plant everything before he was done! He was so tired! You’re a bad person!”

When the man heard that, he finally believed that Lin Fan had planted the coffee.

After all, children usually would not lie.

“Mr. Lin, right? Let me introduce myself first. I’m Zhu Yuanhui, the manager of the Southern Hua Nation region of Magpie Coffee.”

When he spoke, he raised his head and faced Lin Fan. He was extremely arrogant.

Zhu Yuanhui continued, “Our Magpie Coffee is prepared to buy your coffee for one million yuan. What do you think?”

“I’m not interested,” Lin Fan said calmly.

Zhu Yuanhui thought that Lin Fan was trying to raise the price. He laughed coldly. “Mr. Lin, this is the highest price we can offer you. Don’t even think about raising the price.

“Perhaps you don’t know much about Magpie Coffee, so let me give you a simple introduction.

“Magpie Coffee is the largest coffee company in the world, with a total market value of more than a trillion! It’s inextricably linked to all the companies in the world!

“If Magpie Coffee doesn’t buy your coffee beans, then I can guarantee that your coffee beans won’t be able to go out of this mountain!

“Don’t think that you can sell coffee beans online now that the internet is developed. That’s also wishful thinking! That’s because we, Magpie Coffee, have a deep partnership with Penguin Group, Little Tanuki Group, Alphabet Group, and other giant internet companies!”
